name: Indiana
source: Indiana Department of Revenue Departmental Notice 1 via Bloomberg Tax (2.95% for 2026, 2.90% for 2027) and Tax Foundation 2026 table (agree); exemptions read from IDOR Schedule D for Form IT-40PNR (2024) on 2026-10-22

state_base.note: Indiana starts from federal adjusted (or taxable) income and keeps the federal treatment of 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits (no add-back; only California and New Jersey tax HSA deposits). Not checked against a state ruling.

exemptions.note: IDOR Schedule D (2024, primary): 1,000 per filer (2,000 joint), 1,000 per dependent plus 1,500 per qualifying dependent child (2,500 used per dependent), 1,000 per taxpayer or spouse 65 or older or blind. Not modelled: the extra 500 at 65 or older with income under 40,000 (20,000 separate), and the 3,000 adopted-child amount. Tax Foundation 2026 agrees.

estate_inheritance.note: Indiana has no estate tax and repealed its inheritance tax for deaths after 2012 (Tax Foundation 2026 estate and inheritance tax map and state-costs.csv agree). Confirmed primary on https://WWW.IN.GOV/dor/files/dn44.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

social_security.note: Indiana does not tax Social Security benefits; it is not among the states that tax them in Kiplinger 2026 (https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/states-that-tax-social-security-benefits) and state-costs.csv column ss_taxed. Indiana taxes IRA and pension income in full (only military pay and some civil service annuities have deductions), so no retirement_exclusion section. Confirmed primary on https://forms.in.gov/Download.aspx?id=15809 (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice 1 (county income tax rates, yearly)
local_income_tax.note: Every Indiana county taxes its residents' Indiana adjusted gross income less exemptions, retirement income included, at 0.5% (Porter) to 3.0% (Randolph) (Marion 2.02%, Hamilton 1.10%, Allen 1.59%, Lake 1.50%; Departmental Notice 1 effective 2026-10-01, https://www.in.gov/dA/92797e5a5f/dn01.pdf?language_id=1, validation run 2, 2026-10-22). 1.68% is the Tax Foundation's 2023 income-weighted county average (https://taxfoundation.org/blog/indiana-local-income-taxes/); one source only (a Tax Foundation table footnote shows 0.35%, which does not fit the county rates), so unconfirmed.

sales_tax.check_at: Indiana revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.07 from the state's own source (Indiana 7% sales tax due on vehicle sales (https://www.in.gov/dor/files/sib28s.pdf, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food for human consumption exempt; no local sales tax. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.note: Indiana vehicle excise by class and age (12 to 532 a year; a 30,000-35,000 car pays 406 in year 1 and 210 in year 5), about 250 a year averaged, plus about 36 of registration and transportation fees (secondary calculators). Typical car (29,100 list price, 2026 Toyota Camry LE), averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

fuel.source: Excise: https://in.gov/dor/resources/tax-rates-and-reports/rates-fees-and-penalties/miscellaneous-tax-rates (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.37 gasoline license tax from July 2026 to June 2027 (the monthly gasoline use tax stands in for sales tax and is left out; both were suspended for part of 2026 by energy-emergency orders); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Indiana insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
